selection_rules.coop: 1–4 independently chosen kits; world faction/year/order remains host-owned. Runtime roster transport/application not certified by this catalog.
selection_rules.force_mode_2: sp_campaign 0=british,1=russian,2=american,3=german,4=italian,5=polish; Polish is script-only, absent from active campaign menu
selection_rules.history_year: Manual processors contain no year/history restriction; automatic authored loadouts do. Do not infer automatic kits from manual enum.
selection_rules.other_force_modes: sp_ally_nation, then level.campaign; dutch uses British processor; fallback American
selection_rules.slots: Original four independent menu selections; no MG/binocular/smoke exclusion. Same native weapon selected twice does not create two copies.
